routes.intro: Master the art and science of analytics with cutting-edge tools and real-world techniques that drive business growth. Learn to analyze, visualize and interpret data using Excel, SQL, Power BI and Tableau, and step into the market as a job-ready Data Analyst.

faqs.q: Is coding required to join the Data Analytics course?
faqs.a: No prior coding experience is required. The course starts with Excel and SQL fundamentals before introducing Python, so beginners can follow along from the first session.

faqs.q: Does the Data Analytics course include placement assistance?
faqs.a: Yes. SkillKoder provides resume guidance, interview preparation and placement support alongside the technical curriculum.

faqs.q: Which tools will I learn in the Data Analytics course?
faqs.a: You will work with Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau and Python (pandas, NumPy), which are the tools most commonly listed in Data Analyst job descriptions in India.

faqs.q: Is Data Analytics a good career in 2026?
faqs.a: Data Analytics remains one of the most in-demand skill sets across industries, with strong hiring for analysts who can combine SQL, a BI tool and clear business communication.

routes.title: Data Science Course Online with Python | SkillKoder
routes.description: Master Data Science with Python, machine learning and NLP. Live mentorship, real portfolio projects and placement support at SkillKoder.
routes.keywords: data science course online india, data science with python, python data science course, machine learning course online, data scientist training program
routes.intro: Go beyond dashboards and learn to model, predict and automate. Build machine learning and NLP systems in Python with scikit-learn, TensorFlow and PyTorch, guided by mentors and grounded in real project work.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Data Analytics and Data Science?
faqs.a: Data Analytics focuses on describing and explaining what happened using SQL and BI tools. Data Science extends that into prediction and automation using statistics and machine learning.

faqs.q: Do I need a maths background for the Data Science course?
faqs.a: Comfort with school-level maths is enough to start. The required statistics and linear algebra are taught within the course, in the context of the models that use them.

faqs.q: Does the Data Science course include real projects?
faqs.a: Yes. Every learner builds portfolio projects end to end, from data cleaning through modelling to a presentable result you can defend in an interview.

faqs.q: Who should join the Generative AI course?
faqs.a: It suits both beginners curious about AI tools and working professionals who want to build applications on top of large language models.

faqs.q: Will I learn prompt engineering?

faqs.q: Are there career opportunities in Generative AI in India?
faqs.a: Demand is growing quickly for AI developers and prompt engineering specialists as companies move generative AI projects from experiment into production.

routes.intro: Learn the enterprise data stack that companies actually hire for. Design and operate pipelines with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Azure Synapse and Azure Data Lake, and move into one of the highest-paid roles in the data field.

faqs.q: What does an Azure Data Engineer do?
faqs.a: An Azure Data Engineer designs and runs the pipelines that move, clean and store data so analysts and data scientists can use it reliably at scale.

faqs.q: Do I need prior cloud experience for this course?
faqs.a: No. The course covers Azure fundamentals before moving into Data Factory, Databricks and Synapse, so you can start without previous cloud exposure.

faqs.q: Why choose Azure Data Engineering over Data Analytics?
faqs.a: Data engineering roles are less crowded and typically command higher salaries, because they require both programming and infrastructure skills that fewer candidates have.

faqs.q: Is a job guaranteed after completing the course?
faqs.a: No, and you should be cautious of any training provider that promises one. What we provide is placement assistance: resume and portfolio work, mock interviews, technical preparation and job search guidance. Getting hired also depends on your own effort, the roles you target and market conditions at the time.

faqs.q: When does placement support start?
faqs.a: Career support runs alongside the technical curriculum rather than being bolted on at the end. Resume and portfolio work begins once you have your first substantial project, so you are not starting from a blank page in the final week.

faqs.q: How long does placement support last after the course ends?
faqs.a: Support continues past the last class while you are actively interviewing. Speak to us about the current terms for the batch you are joining so you have that in writing before you enrol.

faqs.q: Do you help with roles outside India?
faqs.a: The preparation transfers — the tools and interview formats are broadly the same. Our direct market knowledge and network are strongest in India, so treat guidance on other markets as general rather than specific.

faqs.q: What if I am switching careers from a non-technical background?
faqs.a: Career switchers are a large share of our learners. The extra work is usually positioning rather than technical: framing your existing domain experience as an advantage instead of a gap. That framing is something we work on with you directly.

routes.title: SkillKoder FAQs | Eligibility, Fees, Batches & Placement
routes.description: Answers on eligibility, prerequisites, batch format, duration, certificates and placement support for SkillKoder's Data, Analytics and AI programs.
routes.keywords: skillkoder faq, data analytics course eligibility, is coding required for data analytics, online data science course duration, data course placement support india
routes.intro: Eligibility, prerequisites, batch format, placement support and cost — answered plainly. If your question is not here, ask us directly and we will answer it the same way.

faqs.q: Who can join a SkillKoder course?
faqs.a: Our programs are built for final-year students, recent graduates and working professionals moving into a data or AI role. There is no requirement for a computer science degree — each course starts from fundamentals before moving into advanced material.

faqs.q: Is coding experience required to start?
faqs.a: No. The Data Analytics program begins with Excel and SQL before introducing Python, so complete beginners can follow from the first session. The Data Science, Generative AI and Azure Data Engineering programs assume basic Python comfort, which the Data Analytics track or a short pre-course module will give you.

faqs.q: Are classes live or pre-recorded?
faqs.a: Classes are live and instructor-led, so you can ask questions during the session rather than posting them into a forum and waiting. Sessions are recorded, so you can revisit anything you want to go over again.

faqs.q: What is the course duration?
faqs.a: Duration varies by program and batch schedule. Weekday and weekend batches run at different paces to suit students and working professionals. Contact us or book a free demo class for the current schedule and duration of the batch you are considering.

faqs.q: Do SkillKoder courses include placement assistance?
faqs.a: Yes. Every program includes placement support: resume and LinkedIn review, mock interviews, portfolio guidance and help preparing for technical rounds. This is career support, not a guaranteed job offer — see our placement support page for exactly what is and is not included.

faqs.q: Will I get a certificate at the end?
faqs.a: Yes, you receive a course completion certificate. In practice, hiring managers in this field weigh a portfolio of real projects far more heavily than a certificate, which is why the curriculum is built around project work.

faqs.q: Can I attend a class before paying?
faqs.a: Yes. Book a free demo class to sit in on a live session, see the teaching style and ask about the curriculum before committing to anything.

faqs.q: What happens if I miss a session?
faqs.a: Every session is recorded and made available to your batch, and you can raise anything you did not follow in the next live class or with your mentor.

faqs.q: Which course should I choose?
faqs.a: If you want to analyse data and report on it, start with Data Analytics. If you want to build predictive models, choose Data Science. If you want to build AI applications, choose Generative AI. If you prefer infrastructure and pipelines over analysis, choose Azure Data Engineering. If you are unsure, talk to a career expert — that conversation is free and there is no obligation.

faqs.q: Do you offer courses to students outside India?
faqs.a: Yes. All programs run online, so you can join from anywhere. Batch timings are set in IST, so check that a batch schedule works for your time zone before enrolling.
